name: awesome-opensource-ai
desc: Curated list of the best truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure. Daily updated.

resources.name: PyTorch
resources.desc: Dynamic computation graphs, Pythonic API, dominant in research and production. The current standard for most frontier AI work. !GitHub stars

resources.name: TensorFlow
resources.desc: End-to-end platform with excellent production deployment, TPU support, and large-scale serving tools. !GitHub stars

resources.name: JAX
resources.desc: High-performance numerical computing with composable transformations (JIT, vmap, grad). Rising favorite for research and scientific ML. !GitHub stars

resources.name: Flax
resources.desc: Neural network library for JAX, designed for flexibility. Apache-2.0 licensed. !GitHub stars

resources.name: dm-haiku

resources.name: Equinox

resources.name: NumPyro

resources.name: Keras
resources.desc: High-level, beginner-friendly API that now runs on multiple backends (TensorFlow, JAX, PyTorch). Perfect for rapid experimentation. !GitHub stars

resources.name: tinygrad

resources.name: PaddlePaddle

resources.name: PyTorch Geometric

resources.name: Triton

resources.name: GGML

resources.name: notorch

resources.name: Modular Platform

resources.name: Burn

resources.name: Candle (Hugging Face)

resources.name: sentence-transformers
